# 2 Baruch Chapter 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**38:1** And-he-answered and-said to-me: This-also I-will-explain-to-you, and-everything-which-you-have-asked I-will-explain to-you, because-you-have-been-found-worthy to-be-shown these-things.

**38:2** For-many-have-heard, but-few-have-been-shown; and-one-in-a-generation has-understood.

**38:3** Therefore it-will-be-as-I-said: the-interpretation-of-this-vision will-be-given to-you.

**38:4** And-the-most-perfect-[law]-of-the-Most-High, which-will-not-pass-away or-be-moved, will-judge those-who-are-found-worthy-of-it.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac Codex Ambrosianus. God affirms Baruch's worthiness to receive interpretation (vv.1-2) — a striking claim that few in any generation have understood. Verse 4 introduces the Law as the judge of worthiness, anticipating ch. 39-40's messianic judgment.*
